title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for liver transplant.

HPI: [Copied Forward] Patient is a 33-year-old woman who underwent a liver transplant five years ago. She has been stable on maintenance immunosuppression. She reports no new symptoms and denies any acute concerns.

Update: The patient returns today for a routine follow-up. She reports feeling well and states she has had no issues with her medication adherence. She continues to maintain a stable health status following her liver transplant.

Vitals: BP 118/74, HR 76, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Skin: Negative
HEENT: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative
Psychiatric: Negative

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no organomegaly.
Skin: No new rashes or lesions.

Assessment:
1. Liver transplant: Stable on tacrolimus. Liver function tests remain within normal limits. No evidence of transplant complications.

Plan:
1. Continue current tacrolimus dosage.
2. Routine laboratory monitoring of liver enzymes and tacrolimus trough levels.
3. Follow up in 6 months.

Electronically signed,
